Target Configuration or Required Action: Document the business objectives, technical objectives, security objectives, compliance requirements and expected outcomes
Configuration or Review Path: Project charter and Statement of Work
Validation Method: Review objectives with executive sponsor and technical owner
Exception Criteria: Objectives not finalized before kickoff
Rollback Method: Return charter to draft status and record unresolved decisions
Review Cadence: At project kickoff and after approved scope changes
Engineering Notes: Objectives should be measurable and should identify the business outcome expected from each major technical workstream.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Document included services, excluded services, assumptions, customer responsibilities and implementation boundaries
Configuration or Review Path: Project charter and Statement of Work
Validation Method: Compare approved scope with planned phases and workstreams
Exception Criteria: Scope remains under commercial review
Rollback Method: Maintain unresolved scope items in the decision log
Review Cadence: At project kickoff and after approved scope changes
Engineering Notes: Explicitly identify whether migrations, remediation, licensing purchases, end-user support and third-party systems are included.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define measurable acceptance criteria for identity, endpoint, security, data governance, migration and AI readiness outcomes
Configuration or Review Path: Project charter and acceptance plan
Validation Method: Verify that each in-scope workstream has an acceptance criterion
Exception Criteria: Success criteria require customer approval
Rollback Method: Record interim criteria and unresolved approval owner
Review Cadence: At project kickoff and phase-gate reviews
Engineering Notes: Success criteria should distinguish configuration completion from operational acceptance and user adoption.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify the executive sponsor with authority to approve scope, risk and business-impacting decisions
Configuration or Review Path: Stakeholder register
Validation Method: Confirm sponsor participation and decision authority
Exception Criteria: Customer has not assigned an executive sponsor
Rollback Method: Escalate through the commercial or account owner
Review Cadence: At kickoff and when sponsorship changes
Engineering Notes: The executive sponsor should be able to resolve cross-department ownership and risk-acceptance decisions.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify accountable owners for identity, endpoints, networking, messaging, collaboration, data, security, compliance and applications
Configuration or Review Path: Stakeholder register
Validation Method: Confirm each capability has a named primary owner
Exception Criteria: Capability is outsourced or has no internal owner
Rollback Method: Assign an interim customer decision owner and document the provider contact
Review Cadence: At kickoff and monthly during implementation
Engineering Notes: Use named individuals instead of department names wherever possible.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define technical, security, operational, executive and emergency escalation contacts
Configuration or Review Path: Stakeholder register and communication plan
Validation Method: Test contact data and confirm escalation order
Exception Criteria: After-hours escalation is not included in the engagement
Rollback Method: Document supported escalation hours and alternate contacts
Engineering Notes: Include escalation criteria and expected response times, not only names and telephone numbers.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Schedule workshops for identity, endpoint, infrastructure, applications, messaging, data, governance and AI readiness
Configuration or Review Path: Project schedule
Validation Method: Verify all in-scope capability areas have a scheduled workshop
Exception Criteria: Capability is confirmed out of scope
Rollback Method: Record the exclusion and approval in the decision log
Engineering Notes: Schedule business-owner interviews separately from technical configuration reviews when possible.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Distribute standardized discovery questionnaires before technical workshops
Configuration or Review Path: Project documentation repository
Validation Method: Confirm completed questionnaires are available before each workshop
Exception Criteria: Customer lacks the information needed to complete a questionnaire
Rollback Method: Convert unanswered questions into discovery actions
Engineering Notes: Prework reduces workshop time spent collecting basic tenant, licensing and inventory information.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Document every required portal, role, permission level, approval owner and expected access duration
Configuration or Review Path: Access requirements matrix
Validation Method: Review requested access against least-privilege requirements
Exception Criteria: Customer security policy prohibits delegated access
Rollback Method: Use supervised sessions or customer-executed exports
Review Cadence: At project initiation and when scope changes
Engineering Notes: Avoid requesting Global Administrator when Security Reader, Global Reader or a workload-specific role will satisfy the task.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Provide approved read-only or administrative access required for identity, role, application and Conditional Access discovery
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Identity
Deployment Method: Manual Assignment or Privileged Identity Management
Validation Method: Engineer signs in and verifies required blades and read operations
Evidence Required: Role assignment export and successful access test
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra role availability varies by requested activity
Exception Criteria: Customer policy requires supervised access
Rollback Method: Remove role assignment or expire eligible assignment
Review Cadence: At project initiation and after access changes
Engineering Notes: Prefer Global Reader, Security Reader, Reports Reader, Directory Readers and workload-specific roles during assessment.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Provide approved access to Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, Defender and Purview for in-scope discovery
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft 365 and workload administration portals
Deployment Method: Manual Assignment or Privileged Identity Management
Validation Method: Engineer validates access to each in-scope workload
Evidence Required: Role assignment export and portal access evidence
Exception Criteria: Access cannot be delegated under customer policy
Rollback Method: Use screen-sharing or customer-generated reports
Review Cadence: At project initiation and after access changes
Engineering Notes: Document unavailable portals because missing access can create incomplete assessment results.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify the DNS provider, domain registrar, administrative owner and approved change process
Configuration or Review Path: DNS provider and registrar portals
Validation Method: Verify domain ownership and ability to retrieve current records
Evidence Required: DNS inventory and access validation record
Applies When: Customers with custom domains or planned mail changes
Exception Criteria: Third party retains administrative ownership
Rollback Method: Use approved provider change-request process
Review Cadence: At discovery and before DNS-dependent changes
Engineering Notes: Collect TTL values and existing MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Autodiscover and verification records.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Collect architecture diagrams, policies, procedures, standards, asset lists, contracts and prior assessments
Configuration or Review Path: Approved project document repository
Validation Method: Compare collected documentation with the required-document checklist
Exception Criteria: Document does not exist or cannot be shared
Rollback Method: Record the gap and create a replacement deliverable where in scope
Review Cadence: At project initiation and before design
Engineering Notes: Record document owner, date, version, confidentiality and whether the document is considered authoritative.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Store project evidence in an approved location with restricted membership, versioning and retention
Configuration or Review Path: Customer-approved SharePoint site, Teams site or project repository
Validation Method: Review membership, sharing, version history and retention behavior
Evidence Required: Repository URL, membership export and configuration screenshot
License Requirement: SharePoint Online, Teams or approved alternative
Exception Criteria: Customer mandates a separate governance platform
Rollback Method: Remove external access or migrate evidence to the approved repository
Engineering Notes: Separate general project documents from security-sensitive exports and credentials.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export all endpoints from Intune, Entra, Defender, RMM and other management platforms
Configuration or Review Path: Intune admin center > Devices; Microsoft Entra admin center > Devices; Microsoft Defender portal > Assets
Deployment Method: Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, Portal Export or RMM Export
Validation Method: Reconcile device identifiers, serial numbers, owners and last check-in across sources
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender or RMM licenses as applicable
Exception Criteria: Source platform is inaccessible or outside contract scope
Rollback Method: Re-run export after access restoration
Review Cadence: At discovery and before endpoint design
Engineering Notes: Do not treat a single management platform as the complete inventory until it has been reconciled with Entra and endpoint-security data.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify Entra-registered, Defender-discovered, domain-joined or RMM-visible endpoints that are not enrolled in the approved MDM platform
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center, Microsoft Defender portal, Active Directory and RMM platform
Deployment Method: Portal Export, PowerShell or API Export
Validation Method: Compare approved device inventory with Intune enrollment records
Applies When: Customers with unmanaged or partially managed endpoints
Exclusions: Approved BYOD devices using application protection only
Exception Criteria: Device is approved for an application-protection-only model
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during migration
Engineering Notes: Classify unmanaged devices by corporate ownership, personal ownership, operating system, user and business purpose.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Record operating system, edition, build, patch level and vendor support status for every discoverable device
Configuration or Review Path: Intune, Defender Vulnerability Management, RMM and server-management platforms
Validation Method: Compare discovered versions with approved supported-version standards
Evidence Required: Operating system inventory and unsupported-system report
Applies When: All customers with endpoints or servers
License Requirement: License depends on inventory and vulnerability source
Exception Criteria: Documented business dependency and approved risk acceptance
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly for unsupported systems
Engineering Notes: Separate unsupported operating systems from supported systems that are only missing updates.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Inventory installed desktop applications, managed applications, browser extensions and line-of-business software
Configuration or Review Path: Intune discovered apps, Microsoft Defender inventory, RMM and software-deployment platforms
Validation Method: Compare sources and identify applications lacking owner, publisher, support status or deployment package
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune, Defender or RMM as applicable
Exclusions: Personal applications on approved BYOD devices
Exception Criteria: Application inventory is technically unavailable for approved BYOD
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and quarterly after implementation
Engineering Notes: Identify application version, publisher, install count, deployment source and known business owner.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify application owner, business purpose, authentication method, data sensitivity, user population and outage impact
Configuration or Review Path: Application register and stakeholder interviews
Validation Method: Business owner confirms application information
Exception Criteria: Application owner cannot be identified
Rollback Method: Assign interim technical owner and escalate ownership gap
Review Cadence: At discovery and before identity or device changes
Engineering Notes: Include thick-client applications, SaaS applications, internally developed applications and externally hosted line-of-business systems.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Inventory physical, virtual and cloud servers with role, owner, operating system, support status, network location and dependency data
Configuration or Review Path: Azure portal, virtualization platform, Active Directory, RMM and configuration-management sources
Validation Method: Reconcile server counts across all authoritative platforms
Exception Criteria: System is contractually managed by another provider
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Engineering Notes: Identify domain controllers, certificate services, file servers, application servers, database servers and management servers.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Inventory forests, domains, domain controllers, sites, trusts, functional levels, FSMO roles, DNS and replication topology
Configuration or Review Path: Active Directory Administrative Center, Active Directory Sites and Services, DNS Manager and PowerShell
Validation Method: Validate domain-controller health, replication and DNS registration
Evidence Required: Active Directory topology export and health summary
Applies When: Customers with Active Directory Domain Services
Exclusions: Retired or isolated forests explicitly excluded from scope
Exception Criteria: Forest cannot be accessed or is managed by another provider
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and before hybrid identity design
Engineering Notes: Record time synchronization, SYSVOL replication method, backup status and dependencies on domain authentication.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Inventory approved SaaS applications, owners, authentication methods, data types, licensing and integration dependencies
Configuration or Review Path: Application register, Microsoft Entra enterprise applications and procurement records
Validation Method: Reconcile enterprise applications with the approved application register
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID; advanced discovery may require Defender for Cloud Apps
Exclusions: Personally acquired applications with no corporate data
Exception Criteria: Application is verified as personal and outside organizational use
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Engineering Notes: Flag approved applications that still use local credentials instead of centralized identity.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify cloud applications not present in the approved application register
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Defender portal > Cloud Apps or supported network and endpoint telemetry
Validation Method: Review discovered applications by usage, risk, users and data movement
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps or equivalent discovery capability
Exception Criteria: Application has documented approval pending register update
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly when licensed
Engineering Notes: Do not block applications during discovery unless an immediate material threat requires incident response.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export member users with status, source, licenses, department, manager, creation date, last sign-in and authentication registration
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Users; Microsoft Graph
Validation Method: Compare active users with HR or authoritative personnel records
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID; sign-in and risk detail availability varies by license
Exception Criteria: Test account has documented owner and expiration
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during remediation
Engineering Notes: Flag active accounts without manager, owner, department or business justification.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export guests with sponsor, creation date, invitation status, last sign-in, group memberships and application assignments
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Users > Guest users; Microsoft Graph
Validation Method: Identify guests without sponsors, recent usage or documented purpose
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID; automated access reviews require premium licensing
Exclusions: Provider identities covered by an active agreement
Exception Criteria: Guest has documented sponsor, purpose and review date
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during remediation
Engineering Notes: Differentiate external guests from service-provider administrators and cross-tenant synchronization objects.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify cloud and on-premises service accounts, owners, purpose, authentication method, privilege and application dependency
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory and application-owner interviews
Validation Method: Confirm every service account has an owner and documented dependency
Applies When: Customers with service or automation accounts
License Requirement: None for inventory; workload-identity features vary by license
Exclusions: Managed identities and built-in service principals
Exception Criteria: Object is platform-managed and its purpose has been validated
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Engineering Notes: Flag interactive sign-in, nonexpiring credentials, excessive privileges and accounts without owners.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify inactive, disabled, unlicensed, duplicate and stale identities
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory and Microsoft Graph reporting
Validation Method: Validate inactivity against last sign-in, directory state and authoritative personnel information
License Requirement: Advanced sign-in reporting may require Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2
Exception Criteria: Account has documented owner, reason and review date
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during cleanup
Engineering Notes: Do not use only last interactive sign-in because service and noninteractive activity may indicate continued dependency.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export active, permanent, eligible, group-based and scoped Microsoft Entra role assignments
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Roles and administrators; Privileged Identity Management; Microsoft Graph
Validation Method: Compare assignment scope and status with approved administrative responsibilities
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance required for eligible PIM assignments
Exception Criteria: Emergency account satisfies approved design and monitoring requirements
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during remediation
Engineering Notes: Include assignment type, start date, end date, scope, activation requirements and approval configuration.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify administrators using the same account for privileged administration and normal productivity
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra role export and license assignment report
Validation Method: Compare privileged accounts with mailbox, Teams, OneDrive and productivity-license usage
Exclusions: Small emergency-only environments with approved risk acceptance
Exception Criteria: Customer accepts combined-account risk with compensating controls
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Engineering Notes: Prioritize Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator, Conditional Access Administrator and security roles.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Verify at least two cloud-only emergency-access accounts, credential custody, Conditional Access exclusions and sign-in monitoring
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center and security monitoring platform
Deployment Method: Manual Review and Sign-In Test under approved change
Validation Method: Validate account status, exclusion design, alerting and credential access procedure
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID and available monitoring capability
Exception Criteria: Temporary gap has an approved remediation date and executive risk acceptance
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Engineering Notes: Avoid performing an actual emergency sign-in test without an approved change and monitoring coordination.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export active, suspended, trial and expiring Microsoft cloud subscriptions
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft 365 admin center > Billing; Microsoft Graph subscribed SKUs
Validation Method: Compare purchased quantities, assigned quantities and service-plan status
Exclusions: Partner-owned billing details unavailable to project team
Exception Criteria: CSP provides an authoritative subscription report
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and before final architecture
Engineering Notes: Include Microsoft 365, Entra, Intune, Defender, Purview, Copilot, Azure and add-on subscriptions.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export user licenses, disabled service plans, group-based assignments and direct assignments
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft 365 admin center and Microsoft Entra admin center
Validation Method: Identify duplicate assignments, unlicensed active users and licenses on inactive accounts
Exclusions: Approved shared or resource accounts with workload-specific licenses
Exception Criteria: License is required for documented functionality
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during remediation
Engineering Notes: Separate license entitlement from actual configuration and adoption of the licensed feature.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Map Business Premium, E3, E5, F3 and add-on entitlements to required identity, endpoint, Defender, Purview and Copilot controls
Configuration or Review Path: Licensing workbook and Microsoft service descriptions
Validation Method: Validate every proposed baseline control has a licensing disposition
Exclusions: License-dependent controls not included in contracted scope
Exception Criteria: Mark control as blocked by license or provide an alternative baseline
Rollback Method: At discovery and whenever licensing changes
Support Owner: Record whether each capability is included, requires an add-on, has partial functionality or is unavailable.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Capture current Microsoft Secure Score, category scores and active improvement actions
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Defender portal > Secure Score
Validation Method: Record score date, licensed products and recommendation status
License Requirement: Capabilities reflected in Secure Score vary by assigned licenses
Exclusions: Recommendations not applicable to the customer's environment
Exception Criteria: Document business or technical reason and compensating controls
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Engineering Notes: Do not use the percentage alone; preserve each recommendation, score impact and applicability determination.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Capture incidents, alerts, device exposure score, identity exposures, vulnerabilities and security recommendations
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Defender portal
Deployment Method: Portal Export, API Export or PowerShell
Validation Method: Confirm relevant Defender services are connected and reporting current data
Applies When: Customers licensed for applicable Defender services
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender licensing varies by workload
Exclusions: Workloads not licensed or not deployed
Exception Criteria: Document telemetry limitation and resulting assessment gap
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and weekly during remediation
Engineering Notes: Separate configuration gaps from missing telemetry caused by incomplete onboarding.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export Authentication Methods policy, password protection, SSPR, registration campaign, authentication strengths and legacy MFA state
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods
Deployment Method: Microsoft Graph, PowerShell or Portal Capture
Validation Method: Compare configuration against the approved authentication baseline
License Requirement: Feature availability varies across Microsoft Entra license levels
Exception Criteria: Legacy method is required by a documented business dependency
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and before MFA design
Engineering Notes: Capture both enabled methods and the user or group scope assigned to each method.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export every Conditional Access policy, state, assignment, condition, grant control, session control and exclusion
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access; Microsoft Graph
Validation Method: Validate export count against policies displayed in the portal
Evidence Required: Conditional Access JSON export and summary matrix
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1; risk-based conditions require P2
Exclusions: Microsoft-managed policies should still be inventoried
Exception Criteria: Policy is hidden or unavailable due to permissions
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and before every major enforcement wave
Engineering Notes: Preserve policy IDs because names can change and are not reliable unique identifiers.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export named locations, trusted IP ranges, countries, authentication contexts and Terms of Use objects
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Confirm referenced objects exist and are still used by active policies
Applies When: Customers using these Conditional Access features
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 or applicable feature license
Exclusions: Objects retained for a documented future deployment
Exception Criteria: Object has an approved owner and review date
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Engineering Notes: Identify stale named locations and policies referencing outdated public IP ranges.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export SharePoint sites, Teams, Microsoft 365 groups, templates, storage, activity, owners and external-sharing state
Configuration or Review Path: SharePoint admin center, Teams admin center, Microsoft 365 admin center and Microsoft Graph
Deployment Method: Microsoft Graph, PowerShell or Portal Export
Validation Method: Reconcile Teams, groups and SharePoint sites by object and site identifiers
License Requirement: SharePoint Online and Teams as applicable
Exception Criteria: Object is Microsoft-managed and has no customer governance action
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during governance remediation
Engineering Notes: Identify ownerless, inactive, externally shared, highly permissive and high-storage workspaces.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export OneDrive sites, owners, usage, storage, last activity and external-sharing state
Configuration or Review Path: SharePoint admin center, Microsoft 365 usage reports and PowerShell
Deployment Method: PowerShell, Microsoft Graph or Portal Export
Validation Method: Compare active accounts with active users and leaver records
Exclusions: Preserved OneDrive accounts for former users
Exception Criteria: Retention or legal-hold requirement is documented
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during remediation
Engineering Notes: Identify unowned OneDrive sites, former-user content and excessive external sharing.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Inventory SMB shares, NTFS permissions, data volume, file count, ownership, source platform and migration constraints
Configuration or Review Path: File servers, Egnyte, Box, Dropbox or other storage administration portals
Deployment Method: Native Export, Scripted Inventory or Migration Assessment Tool
Validation Method: Validate inventory totals with storage owners and platform reports
License Requirement: Source-platform access and migration-tool licensing as applicable
Exclusions: Archive repositories explicitly outside project scope
Exception Criteria: Repository exclusion is approved and documented
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and before information-architecture design
Engineering Notes: Collect blocked file types, path-length issues, invalid characters, stale content and permission complexity.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export tenant and site external-sharing levels, guest settings, default-link types and domain restrictions
Configuration or Review Path: SharePoint admin center, Teams admin center and Microsoft Entra external collaboration settings
Deployment Method: PowerShell, Microsoft Graph or Portal Export
Validation Method: Compare tenant maximums with individual site configurations
License Requirement: Base Microsoft 365 licensing; advanced governance features vary
Exception Criteria: Site has documented business purpose, owner and review cadence
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Engineering Notes: A site setting less restrictive than expected should be reviewed even when it is permitted by the tenant maximum.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify Anyone links, organization-wide links, externally shared files and stale sharing links
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Purview, SharePoint Advanced Management, Microsoft Graph or approved reporting tool
Validation Method: Sample results with site owners and validate current access
License Requirement: Advanced discovery may require Microsoft Purview or SharePoint Advanced Management
Exception Criteria: Public sharing is documented, approved and monitored
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during remediation
Engineering Notes: Prioritize links exposing sensitive, executive, financial, HR, legal and security information.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify Everyone, Everyone except external users, broad security groups, direct permissions and excessive site membership
Configuration or Review Path: SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft 365 Groups and Microsoft Graph
Validation Method: Validate high-risk permissions with site and data owners
License Requirement: Base administration; advanced analysis may require additional governance licensing
Exception Criteria: Business owner approves broad access and content is suitable for the audience
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during remediation
Engineering Notes: Record permission source, affected object, principal, owner, sensitivity and remediation priority.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify files, folders, libraries and sites with unique permissions or direct user assignments
Configuration or Review Path: SharePoint Online administration tools, Microsoft Graph or approved assessment tooling
Validation Method: Sample identified locations and confirm permission path
Exclusions: Approved secure workspaces with intentionally unique permissions
Exception Criteria: Business owner documents the design and review process
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and before migration or AI rollout
Engineering Notes: Large numbers of unique permissions indicate a governance and supportability risk even when access is technically correct.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export sensitivity labels, priorities, scopes, protection settings and publishing policies
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Information Protection
Deployment Method: PowerShell, Portal Export or Microsoft Graph where supported
Validation Method: Compare label definitions with publishing policy assignments
Applies When: Customers using Microsoft Purview Information Protection
License Requirement: Microsoft Purview Information Protection licensing varies by feature
Exclusions: Retired labels preserved for existing content
Exception Criteria: Label retirement is documented and content impact is understood
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Engineering Notes: Capture user-facing label names and immutable identifiers where available.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export DLP policies, locations, rules, sensitive information types, actions, notifications, overrides and policy mode
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Loss Prevention
Validation Method: Compare deployed policy count with exported policy count and assignments
License Requirement: License varies by workload and DLP capability
Exclusions: Microsoft-managed or test policies should remain inventoried
Exception Criteria: Policy is inactive but retained under an approved change plan
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and before DLP redesign
Engineering Notes: Flag policies configured directly in enforcement without documented simulation and validation.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export retention policies, retention labels, event types, record settings, adaptive scopes and disposition configuration
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management and Records Management
Validation Method: Validate policy and label assignments against documented retention requirements
Applies When: Customers using retention or records management
License Requirement: Microsoft Purview licensing varies by feature
Exclusions: Policies owned by legal or records teams remain in scope for inventory
Exception Criteria: Technical team lacks authority to alter a legally managed policy
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and before lifecycle design
Engineering Notes: Do not recommend removal of retention controls without legal and records-management review.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify approved and unapproved AI services, Microsoft 365 Copilot users, Copilot Studio environments, agents and AI-connected applications
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft 365 admin center, Power Platform admin center, Microsoft Purview and application inventory
Deployment Method: Portal Export, API Export and Stakeholder Review
Validation Method: Reconcile licensing, usage, applications, agents, owners and approved-use list
Applies When: Customers using or planning AI services
License Requirement: License depends on Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and connected services
Exclusions: Personal AI services with no organizational authorization or data access
Exception Criteria: Service is verified outside corporate use and addressed through policy
Rollback Method: No configuration change during discovery
Review Cadence: At discovery and monthly during AI adoption
Engineering Notes: Include consumer AI access, browser extensions, developer tools and third-party SaaS products with embedded AI.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify repositories approved as authoritative sources for Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent grounding
Configuration or Review Path: Data repository inventory and business-owner interviews
Validation Method: Data owner confirms authority, accuracy, completeness and maintenance responsibility
License Requirement: No license required for assessment; validation requires applicable AI licensing
Exclusions: Draft, duplicate, obsolete and unowned repositories
Exception Criteria: Repository has a documented remediation plan and limited pilot exposure
Rollback Method: Remove repository from approved grounding list
Engineering Notes: Authority should be based on business ownership and data quality, not merely on where content is currently stored.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Assess whether broad permissions, anonymous links, stale guests or duplicate content could expose inappropriate information through AI retrieval
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Purview, SharePoint governance reports, permission reports and approved AI testing
Validation Method: Test representative personas and compare retrieval with effective access
License Requirement: Advanced assessment and testing may require Microsoft Purview, SharePoint Advanced Management or Microsoft 365 Copilot
Exception Criteria: Broad access is documented, approved and appropriate for all intended users
Rollback Method: Limit AI pilot scope or remediate repository access
Review Cadence: Before AI pilot and before production expansion
Engineering Notes: AI normally uses existing permissions, so oversharing must be treated as an access-governance issue.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define cloud-only or hybrid identity, authentication, privileged access, lifecycle and application-integration target state
Configuration or Review Path: Architecture repository
Validation Method: Architecture review with identity, security and infrastructure owners
License Requirement: Target capabilities depend on selected Microsoft licenses
Exclusions: Legacy applications requiring existing identity services
Exception Criteria: Dependency has documented owner, risk and retirement plan
Rollback Method: Return architecture to prior approved version
Review Cadence: At design approval and after material identity changes
Engineering Notes: Identify both interim and long-term identity states when immediate cloud-only transition is not practical.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define join model, enrollment method, management platform, compliance, security tooling, provisioning and support model
Configuration or Review Path: Architecture repository
Validation Method: Architecture review with endpoint, identity, security and support owners
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune, Entra and Defender licensing according to design
Exception Criteria: Device class has approved alternative management and risk treatment
Rollback Method: Return architecture to prior approved version
Review Cadence: At design approval and after major platform changes
Engineering Notes: Separate corporate Windows, Apple, mobile BYOD, shared devices, servers and specialized devices.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define collaboration, repository, information architecture, governance, Purview, Copilot and agent grounding target state
Configuration or Review Path: Architecture repository
Validation Method: Architecture review with data owners, security, compliance and AI governance stakeholders
Applies When: Customers modernizing data or adopting AI
License Requirement: Licensing depends on selected Microsoft 365, Purview, Fabric, Copilot and Power Platform capabilities
Exception Criteria: Repository has documented integration, security and lifecycle design
Rollback Method: Return architecture to prior approved version
Review Cadence: At design approval and after major data-platform changes
Engineering Notes: Document authoritative data boundaries, search exposure, external sharing, connector controls and agent lifecycle.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Compare current identity, endpoint, application, infrastructure, security, data and AI capabilities against approved target states
Configuration or Review Path: Gap analysis workbook
Validation Method: Every target capability has a current-state and gap disposition
Exception Criteria: Information required to assess a capability is unavailable
Rollback Method: Mark gap as not assessed with a documented data requirement
Review Cadence: At discovery closeout and phase-gate reviews
Engineering Notes: Use consistent dispositions such as compliant, partial, missing, blocked by license, blocked by dependency and not applicable.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Score identified gaps by likelihood, business impact, exposure, regulatory effect and remediation urgency
Configuration or Review Path: Risk register
Validation Method: Review scoring with technical owners, security and executive sponsor
Exception Criteria: Customer uses a different approved risk methodology
Rollback Method: Map results into the customer methodology
Engineering Notes: Separate inherent risk, compensating controls, residual risk, remediation owner and target date.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Sequence remediation and modernization by risk, dependency, business impact, readiness and available engineering capacity
Configuration or Review Path: Implementation roadmap
Validation Method: Validate that every activity has predecessors, owner and target phase
Exception Criteria: External project or contract changes sequencing
Rollback Method: Update dependency map and obtain roadmap approval
Engineering Notes: Identity, emergency access and foundational security should normally precede broad enforcement, migration and AI expansion.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Assign engineering effort, calendar duration, customer effort and complexity assumptions to roadmap activities
Configuration or Review Path: WBS and resource plan
Validation Method: Compare estimates with scope volumes and dependency assumptions
Exception Criteria: Scope volume cannot yet be measured
Rollback Method: Use an estimate range and identify the measurement dependency
Review Cadence: At discovery closeout and after approved scope changes
Engineering Notes: Keep engineering effort separate from elapsed time because observation windows, stakeholder availability and migration runtime affect duration.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define who recommends, approves, implements and accepts risk for technical and business decisions
Configuration or Review Path: Governance plan and RACI
Validation Method: Confirm role assignments with executive sponsor and workstream owners
Exception Criteria: Customer uses an existing governance model
Rollback Method: Map project roles to the existing model
Review Cadence: At kickoff and after governance changes
Engineering Notes: Distinguish technical approval from business ownership and formal risk acceptance.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define status, milestone, risk, issue, decision, dependency, budget and resource reporting cadence
Configuration or Review Path: Project governance plan
Validation Method: Verify recurring meetings and reports are scheduled
Evidence Required: Status report template and meeting schedule
Exception Criteria: Customer governance cadence supersedes project cadence
Rollback Method: Use customer cadence and map required project artifacts
Engineering Notes: Use a consistent status method that separates delivery health from technical risk and customer dependencies.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define intake, analysis, approval, scheduling, testing, implementation, validation, rollback and closure requirements
Configuration or Review Path: Change-management platform and project governance plan
Validation Method: Walk through a representative technical change from request to closure
Exception Criteria: Emergency process is documented and requires retrospective review
Rollback Method: Revert to previous approved process version
Engineering Notes: Every enforcement change should have validation criteria, rollback steps and a support communication plan.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define executive, technical, support, department and end-user communication audiences and channels
Configuration or Review Path: Communication plan
Validation Method: Confirm audience owner, sender, delivery method and approval path
Exception Criteria: Customer communications team controls delivery
Rollback Method: Document handoff dates and approval requirements
Review Cadence: At kickoff and before user-impacting changes
Engineering Notes: Include outage notices, pilot invitations, enrollment campaigns, enforcement notices and post-change support guidance.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Assess training needs, support readiness, organizational change impact, user populations and adoption risks
Configuration or Review Path: Change-readiness workbook
Validation Method: Review readiness findings with support, communications and business owners
Exclusions: Purely backend changes without user impact
Exception Criteria: Technical owner verifies that no workflow or support impact exists
Rollback Method: Update readiness plan when scope or deployment method changes
Engineering Notes: Map readiness requirements to MFA registration, device enrollment, security prompts, data labeling, DLP and AI adoption.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define approved user creation, license assignment, group membership, manager assignment and initial authentication registration procedures
Configuration or Review Path: Customer HR system, identity platform and Microsoft Entra admin center
Validation Method: Process walkthrough using a test identity
Exception Criteria: Account type requires a separately approved process
Rollback Method: Disable test identity and reverse assignments
Engineering Notes: Use the authoritative personnel source wherever possible and avoid unsupported manual creation outside the approved workflow.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define role-change procedures for department, manager, title, license, group, application and privileged-access changes
Configuration or Review Path: Customer HR system, Microsoft Entra ID and application-management platforms
Validation Method: Process walkthrough using a representative role change
Exception Criteria: Business role cannot be represented through standard group assignment
Rollback Method: Restore prior attributes and access assignments
Engineering Notes: Remove old access as part of the role change rather than only adding access required by the new role.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Disable sign-in, revoke sessions, remove licenses, remove group membership, transfer data and initiate retention procedures
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center, Microsoft 365 admin center and workload administration portals
Validation Method: Test with a nonproduction identity and confirm session revocation and access removal
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID and applicable workload licenses
Exclusions: Legal-hold accounts and approved service identities
Exception Criteria: Legal or operational requirement prevents standard deletion
Rollback Method: Restore account only through approved rehire or incident procedure
Engineering Notes: Separate immediate access termination from later mailbox, OneDrive and account deletion.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Identify accounts with no approved activity for 45 days and route them for owner validation, disabling or exception
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Users; Microsoft Graph; Active Directory when hybrid
Validation Method: Compare last sign-in, noninteractive activity and owner response
License Requirement: Reporting depth varies by Microsoft Entra license
Exclusions: Service accounts, approved leave and emergency accounts
Exception Criteria: Documented owner, business purpose and next review date
Rollback Method: Re-enable account through approved identity process
Engineering Notes: Do not disable accounts based solely on interactive sign-in if noninteractive activity or application dependency exists.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Remove unnecessary licenses from disabled accounts after mailbox, OneDrive, retention and legal requirements are confirmed
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft 365 admin center and Microsoft Entra admin center
Validation Method: Confirm disabled accounts no longer consume unnecessary licenses
Exception Criteria: Legal hold, preserved mailbox or licensed workload dependency
Rollback Method: Reassign required license through approved change
Engineering Notes: Do not remove licenses until retention and data-transfer effects have been reviewed.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require every guest account to have an accountable internal sponsor and documented business purpose
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra ID, entitlement management or guest register
Validation Method: Sample guests and verify sponsor and purpose
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID; automated lifecycle features may require Entra ID Governance
Exclusions: Cross-tenant synchronization identities and approved provider accounts
Exception Criteria: Sponsor temporarily unavailable with a delegated owner assigned
Rollback Method: Remove or disable guest access
Engineering Notes: Sponsor ownership should be updated when the original sponsor leaves or changes roles.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Set approved guest access packages or collaboration access to expire and require renewal
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Identity Governance or documented manual process
Deployment Method: Entitlement Management, Access Reviews or Manual Governance
Validation Method: Validate expiration behavior with a pilot guest
Evidence Required: Guest expiration configuration and test evidence
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID Governance or P2 for automated governance
Exclusions: Long-term provider accounts with contract-aligned reviews
Exception Criteria: Approved exception with sponsor, expiration and review date
Rollback Method: Extend access through approved renewal
Engineering Notes: Expiration does not replace recurring access reviews or sponsor accountability.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Configure recurring reviews for guest users, guest group memberships and sensitive applications
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Identity Governance > Access reviews
Validation Method: Run pilot review and validate reviewer decisions and remediation
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance
Exclusions: Emergency provider identities with separate review
Exception Criteria: Automated review is unavailable or inappropriate for the object
Rollback Method: Stop automated remediation and restore access through approval
Engineering Notes: Validate reviewer participation before enabling automatic removal of denied or nonresponsive access.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require documented owner, purpose, application dependency, privilege and authentication method for each service account
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory and service-account register
Validation Method: Review all service accounts for complete ownership metadata
Exception Criteria: Account is vendor-managed with a documented contract owner
Rollback Method: Disable account only after dependency validation
Engineering Notes: Unowned service accounts should be escalated as a security and operational risk.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Block interactive sign-in for service accounts unless an approved dependency requires it
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access, account properties or Active Directory logon controls
Deployment Method: Conditional Access, Account Restriction or Application Migration
Validation Method: Test required workload process and interactive sign-in denial
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 when Conditional Access is used
Exclusions: Accounts with validated interactive operational requirements
Exception Criteria: Approved owner, purpose, compensating MFA and expiration
Rollback Method: Disable policy or remove account from scoped group
Engineering Notes: Prefer managed identities, workload identities, certificates or managed service accounts over reusable passwords.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Configure organization-specific banned terms including company names, brands, locations and predictable patterns
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Password protection
Validation Method: Attempt representative prohibited passwords in a controlled test
Evidence Required: Password-protection configuration screenshot and test result
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 for custom banned-password list
Exception Criteria: Customer declines custom terms after documented risk review
Rollback Method: Remove recently added custom terms
Engineering Notes: Do not place actual passwords or confidential terms in project evidence.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Enable Microsoft Entra smart lockout using approved threshold and duration values
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Password protection
Validation Method: Review sign-in logs and controlled lockout behavior
Exclusions: Emergency-access accounts remain monitored but should not bypass native protection
Exception Criteria: Legacy application behavior creates repeated authentication failures
Rollback Method: Restore previous threshold and duration
Engineering Notes: Avoid aggressive values that create user denial-of-service risk.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Deploy Microsoft Entra Password Protection proxy and domain-controller agents and enable enforcement after audit validation
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center and on-premises Active Directory servers
Validation Method: Validate agent health and review audit or enforcement events
Evidence Required: Agent inventory, health output and event-log samples
Applies When: Customers with Active Directory Domain Services
Pilot Group: Pilot domain and controlled password changes
Exception Criteria: Documented technical limitation and compensating password controls
Rollback Method: Return policy to audit mode or uninstall agents through approved change
Engineering Notes: Confirm proxy redundancy and domain-controller agent coverage before enforcing.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Manage authentication methods through the tenant Authentication Methods policy and retire disconnected legacy method configuration
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods
Validation Method: Export enabled methods and assigned groups
Exclusions: Emergency-access accounts according to approved design
Exception Criteria: Legacy dependency requires temporary method availability
Rollback Method: Restore prior method scope
Engineering Notes: Each enabled method should have an approved target population and business justification.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Disable SMS and voice authentication for privileged users and reduce use for standard users as stronger methods are deployed
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods
Validation Method: Validate privileged users cannot register or use disallowed methods
Exclusions: Users without supported strong methods during migration
Exception Criteria: Time-bound exception with approved method migration date
Rollback Method: Restore method scope temporarily
Engineering Notes: Do not remove a user's only working method until registration and recovery paths are verified.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Enable Temporary Access Pass for controlled onboarding, passwordless registration and account recovery
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Temporary Access Pass
Validation Method: Create and redeem a TAP for a test account
Evidence Required: Policy export and successful test result
Applies When: Customers using secure onboarding or passwordless methods
Exception Criteria: Customer lacks an approved identity-verification process
Rollback Method: Disable TAP method or remove group scope
Engineering Notes: Use short lifetimes, limited use and documented identity verification before issuance.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Enable Microsoft Authenticator push notifications for approved users
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Microsoft Authenticator
Validation Method: Register test user and complete MFA challenge
Exception Criteria: User lacks a compatible device and has an approved alternative
Rollback Method: Remove pilot assignment or restore alternative method
Engineering Notes: Microsoft Authenticator should not be the only method available for account recovery.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require number matching for Microsoft Authenticator push authentication
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Microsoft Authenticator
Validation Method: Complete test push and verify number entry is required
Exception Criteria: Temporary Microsoft service limitation
Rollback Method: Restore prior Authenticator configuration
Engineering Notes: Include user communications explaining that unexpected prompts must be denied and reported.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Enable application name and geographic location context in Authenticator notifications where supported
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Microsoft Authenticator
Validation Method: Verify context appears during a controlled sign-in
Exception Criteria: Context causes a documented accessibility or technical issue
Rollback Method: Restore previous Authenticator configuration
Engineering Notes: Location context is informational and must not be treated as definitive proof of sign-in origin.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Enable Microsoft Authenticator passwordless phone sign-in for approved users and supported scenarios
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods
Validation Method: Complete passwordless sign-in with a pilot user
Exception Criteria: User workflow is incompatible with passwordless sign-in
Rollback Method: Remove user from passwordless scope
Engineering Notes: Use phishing-resistant methods for privileged roles when possible rather than relying only on phone sign-in.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Enable combined registration for MFA and self-service password reset
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Users > Password reset or Authentication methods
Validation Method: Complete registration with a pilot user and verify methods appear correctly
Exception Criteria: Temporary service limitation
Rollback Method: Restore prior registration behavior if supported
Engineering Notes: Update support documentation to reflect the combined registration interface.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Configure a registration campaign for Microsoft Authenticator or approved stronger methods
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Authentication methods > Registration campaign
Validation Method: Verify pilot users receive the registration prompt and can complete or defer according to design
Exclusions: Service accounts, emergency accounts and unsupported users
Exception Criteria: Approved user cannot complete registration before enforcement date
Rollback Method: Exclude temporarily with expiration
Engineering Notes: Coordinate campaign timing with communications and help-desk readiness.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Create or validate a standard multifactor authentication strength for ordinary user access
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > Authentication strengths
Validation Method: Apply in report-only test policy and validate accepted methods
Applies When: Customers using Conditional Access authentication strengths
Exception Criteria: Required legacy method is not represented and has an approved retirement plan
Rollback Method: Remove strength from test policy
Engineering Notes: Document accepted methods and avoid silently changing them without impact analysis.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Use the built-in or approved custom phishing-resistant authentication strength for privileged roles and sensitive resources
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > Authentication strengths
Validation Method: Test FIDO2, passkey or certificate-based authentication with pilot administrators
Evidence Required: Strength export and successful sign-in evidence
Applies When: Customers protecting privileged or sensitive access
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 and compatible authentication method support
Exception Criteria: Administrator lacks compatible authentication method during migration
Rollback Method: Temporarily restore standard MFA requirement
Engineering Notes: Complete method registration and recovery planning before enforcement.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Migrate users from per-user MFA to Conditional Access and set legacy per-user MFA state to disabled after validation
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center and Microsoft 365 legacy MFA management
Validation Method: Compare Conditional Access coverage and complete representative sign-in tests
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 for Conditional Access
Exclusions: Accounts not yet covered by approved Conditional Access controls
Exception Criteria: Temporary exception with migration target date
Rollback Method: Re-enable per-user MFA only for emergency rollback
Engineering Notes: Do not disable legacy enforcement until equivalent Conditional Access coverage is confirmed.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Remove Duo, Okta or other third-party MFA dependencies only after Microsoft authentication and Conditional Access are validated
Configuration or Review Path: Third-party MFA console, Microsoft Entra ID and application configurations
Validation Method: Test all protected applications and user personas
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 and applicable Microsoft authentication licenses
Exclusions: Applications with approved temporary third-party dependency
Exception Criteria: Dependency has owner and retirement date
Rollback Method: Restore third-party integration through vendor-approved rollback
Engineering Notes: Preserve vendor access and rollback capability until production acceptance.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Enable SSPR for approved users using strong authentication methods and appropriate registration requirements
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Password reset
Validation Method: Reset a test user's password and verify notifications and audit events
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 for hybrid writeback scenarios
Exclusions: Privileged and emergency accounts according to approved policy
Exception Criteria: User population lacks approved recovery methods
Rollback Method: Remove group from SSPR scope
Engineering Notes: Require adequate method count and avoid weak recovery combinations for privileged identities.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Enable password writeback after validating connectivity, permissions, password policy and rollback
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra Connect or Cloud Sync configuration and Microsoft Entra admin center
Validation Method: Complete password reset for a pilot synchronized user
Evidence Required: Writeback configuration, event logs and test result
Applies When: Hybrid customers requiring cloud password reset
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 and supported synchronization configuration
Exclusions: Privileged or specially controlled on-premises accounts
Exception Criteria: Directory architecture or policy cannot safely support writeback
Rollback Method: Disable writeback and use existing recovery process
Engineering Notes: Monitor connector service health and on-premises event logs after enablement.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Review all active, permanent, eligible, scoped and group-based administrative assignments
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Roles and administrators; Privileged Identity Management
Deployment Method: Microsoft Graph Export and Manual Review
Validation Method: Obtain role-owner validation for every privileged assignment
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance for PIM data
Exception Criteria: Approved role with documented owner and review date
Rollback Method: No automatic rollback during assessment
Engineering Notes: Prioritize Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator and Conditional Access Administrator.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Replace broad roles with workload-specific or task-specific roles where feasible
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Roles and administrators
Validation Method: Engineer completes required administrative task using reduced role
Exception Criteria: Required task cannot be completed using available least-privileged roles
Rollback Method: Restore prior role temporarily through approved change
Engineering Notes: Use built-in or carefully designed custom roles rather than permanent Global Administrator access.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Provide separate privileged accounts for administrators and prohibit productivity use from those accounts
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra ID, licensing assignments and administrative procedures
Validation Method: Verify privileged accounts lack mailbox and unnecessary productivity services
Exception Criteria: Small environment has approved temporary combined-account model
Rollback Method: Disable dedicated account or restore prior role assignment
Engineering Notes: Privileged accounts should be cloud-only where practical and protected by stronger authentication.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Convert approved standing privileged assignments to eligible, time-bound assignments
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Identity Governance > Privileged Identity Management
Validation Method: Activate role and complete required task with pilot administrator
Evidence Required: PIM assignment export and activation evidence
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance
Exclusions: Emergency-access accounts and documented service principals
Exception Criteria: Role does not support eligible assignment or operational availability requires standing access
Rollback Method: Restore active assignment through approved change
Engineering Notes: Use expiration dates for eligible assignments instead of indefinite eligibility where feasible.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require MFA or an approved authentication strength for privileged-role activation
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > PIM > Role settings
Validation Method: Activate role with pilot administrator and verify authentication challenge
Evidence Required: Role settings export and activation log
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance
Exception Criteria: Temporary authentication-method migration issue
Rollback Method: Restore prior activation control temporarily
Engineering Notes: Use phishing-resistant strength for the highest-impact roles when registered methods support it.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require meaningful justification and a change or ticket reference for privileged-role activation
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > PIM > Role settings
Validation Method: Activate role and confirm required fields are captured
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance
Exception Criteria: Incident prevents advance ticket creation and retrospective reference is required
Rollback Method: Restore prior role setting
Engineering Notes: Define an acceptable justification format so activation logs are operationally useful.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require approval for Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator and other designated sensitive roles
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > PIM > Role settings
Validation Method: Submit pilot activation and verify approver workflow
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance
Exception Criteria: Approver coverage cannot meet approved operational SLA
Rollback Method: Temporarily restore activation without approval through emergency change
Engineering Notes: Assign multiple qualified approvers and prevent self-approval.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Limit activation duration according to role sensitivity and operational need
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > PIM > Role settings
Validation Method: Verify role deactivates at the configured expiration
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance
Exclusions: Long-running approved maintenance requiring extended activation
Exception Criteria: Time-bound exception with change approval
Rollback Method: Restore prior duration setting
Engineering Notes: High-impact roles should use shorter activation periods than routine workload-administration roles.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Maintain at least two cloud-only emergency-access accounts with Global Administrator and secure credential custody
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Users and Roles
Deployment Method: Manual Configuration and Secure Credential Storage
Validation Method: Validate accounts are enabled, cloud-only and available through approved test
Exception Criteria: Temporary remediation in progress with executive risk acceptance
Rollback Method: Disable or rotate account through emergency procedure
Engineering Notes: Accounts should use different failure dependencies from normal administrative authentication.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Alert on every sign-in attempt and credential or role change affecting emergency-access accounts
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra sign-in logs, audit logs and monitoring platform
Validation Method: Perform approved monitored test and verify notification delivery
License Requirement: Monitoring and log-routing licenses depend on solution
Exception Criteria: Monitoring platform is temporarily unavailable
Rollback Method: Use Microsoft Entra native alerting and manual daily review
Engineering Notes: Alert on failed attempts as well as successful sign-ins.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Configure recurring reviews for active and eligible privileged-role assignments
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Identity Governance > Privileged Identity Management
Validation Method: Run pilot review and validate reviewer decisions
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance
Exclusions: Emergency-access accounts reviewed through separate procedure
Exception Criteria: Reviewer availability prevents automation
Rollback Method: Run documented manual review
Engineering Notes: Review both permanent and eligible assignments and remediate denied access promptly.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Use a consistent policy identifier and name containing sequence, persona, resource and control purpose
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Review all policies for naming compliance
Exception Criteria: Policy is Microsoft-managed and cannot be renamed
Rollback Method: Not Applicable
Engineering Notes: Example pattern: CA001-All-Block-LegacyAuth.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Explicitly exclude approved emergency-access accounts from applicable Conditional Access policies
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Review every policy assignment and verify emergency exclusions
Exception Criteria: No exception permitted without replacement emergency architecture
Rollback Method: Disable affected policy or restore exclusion
Engineering Notes: Emergency accounts remain monitored and should not be excluded from non-Conditional Access controls unnecessarily.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Create controlled pilot, staged rollout and temporary exception groups with owners and expiration procedures
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Groups
Validation Method: Verify group ownership, membership and naming
Exception Criteria: Exception has approved owner, reason and expiration
Rollback Method: Remove membership or delete unused group
Engineering Notes: Do not use permanently unmanaged exclusion groups.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Block Exchange ActiveSync and other legacy authentication clients for all users and cloud applications
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Review report-only results and test modern clients
Exclusions: Emergency-access accounts and documented temporary dependency accounts
Exception Criteria: Application has confirmed legacy dependency and remediation plan
Rollback Method: Disable policy or add time-bound exception
Review Cadence: Monthly during rollout and quarterly thereafter
Engineering Notes: Review SMTP AUTH, scanners and line-of-business applications separately before enforcement.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require phishing-resistant authentication strength for privileged administrative roles
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Test each covered role with registered strong authentication method
Evidence Required: Policy JSON, sign-in logs and test evidence
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 and compatible strong authentication methods
Exception Criteria: Administrator has approved temporary method migration exception
Rollback Method: Disable policy or restore standard MFA policy
Review Cadence: Monthly during rollout and quarterly thereafter
Engineering Notes: Confirm all covered administrators can authenticate before enforcement.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require approved multifactor authentication for applicable users and cloud applications
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Review report-only impact and complete browser, desktop, mobile and application tests
Exclusions: Emergency-access accounts, service accounts and documented technical exceptions
Exception Criteria: Approved dependency with owner and expiration
Rollback Method: Disable policy or add time-bound exception
Review Cadence: Monthly during rollout and quarterly thereafter
Engineering Notes: Avoid creating overlapping MFA policies with inconsistent exclusions.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require MFA or approved authentication strength for Microsoft Azure management resources
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Test Azure portal, Azure PowerShell and Azure CLI access
Exclusions: Emergency-access accounts and approved automation identities
Exception Criteria: Automation incorrectly uses user authentication and has a remediation plan
Rollback Method: Disable policy or restore exception
Engineering Notes: Workload identities should be governed separately and should not rely on user exclusions.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require MFA or trusted inbound cross-tenant MFA claims for guest and external users
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access and Cross-tenant access settings
Validation Method: Test local MFA and trusted external MFA scenarios
Evidence Required: Policy JSON, cross-tenant settings and sign-in evidence
Exclusions: Emergency provider identities under separate control
Exception Criteria: Partner identity platform cannot satisfy approved trust requirements
Rollback Method: Disable policy or add time-bound exception
Engineering Notes: Document whether external MFA and device claims are trusted for each partner.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Require devices to be marked compliant for approved Microsoft 365 or sensitive applications
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Verify pilot devices are enrolled, compliant and able to access target resources
Evidence Required: Policy JSON, compliance evidence and sign-in logs
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 and Microsoft Intune
Exclusions: Emergency-access accounts and approved BYOD application-protection path
Exception Criteria: Unsupported device class has approved alternative protection
Rollback Method: Disable policy or remove target application temporarily
Review Cadence: Monthly during rollout and quarterly thereafter
Engineering Notes: Do not enforce until at least one representative device per supported platform reports compliant.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Block or require secure remediation for users with high risk
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Use risk simulation or approved test method and review Identity Protection results
Evidence Required: Policy JSON and risk-response test evidence
Applies When: Customers licensed for risk-based Conditional Access
Exception Criteria: False-positive risk has been investigated and temporarily dismissed
Rollback Method: Disable policy or restore prior risk policy
