Target Configuration or Required Action: Block high-risk sign-ins and require MFA for approved medium-risk scenarios
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Review risky sign-ins and test support and investigation workflow
Evidence Required: Policy JSON and incident workflow evidence
Applies When: Customers licensed for risk-based Conditional Access
Exception Criteria: Confirmed false-positive or approved investigation exception
Rollback Method: Disable policy or change risk threshold
Engineering Notes: Define who investigates blocked users and how access is safely restored.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define trusted public IP ranges only for explicitly approved corporate egress locations
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > Named locations
Validation Method: Verify public IP ownership and compare against current network egress
Exception Criteria: Dynamic or shared public addressing cannot be trusted reliably
Rollback Method: Remove location from policies
Engineering Notes: Trusted location status should not by itself bypass MFA for general users.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Define approved and blocked country locations based on actual business operations and travel requirements
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > Named locations
Validation Method: Compare locations with business and travel requirements
Exception Criteria: Business operates in or must access from otherwise restricted country
Rollback Method: Time-bound travel exception
Engineering Notes: Country blocking is a supplemental control and may be affected by VPN and proxy use.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Configure sign-in frequency by persona and resource sensitivity rather than using one tenant-wide value
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > Session controls
Validation Method: Test browser, Office client and mobile reauthentication behavior
Evidence Required: Policy JSON and user-experience test results
Exclusions: Emergency-access accounts and incompatible legacy applications
Exception Criteria: Documented operational impact exceeds security benefit
Rollback Method: Disable session control or restore prior frequency
Engineering Notes: Avoid unnecessarily frequent prompts that encourage unsafe approval behavior.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Disable persistent browser sessions for privileged users and other high-risk personas
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access > Session controls
Validation Method: Close and reopen browser and verify authentication behavior
Exception Criteria: Administrative workflow has documented incompatibility
Rollback Method: Disable session control temporarily
Engineering Notes: Combine with separate privileged accounts and phishing-resistant authentication.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Use application-enforced restrictions or approved session controls to limit downloads from unmanaged devices
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access, SharePoint admin center and Defender for Cloud Apps when applicable
Validation Method: Test browser access, preview, download and synchronization on unmanaged device
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1; advanced session controls may require Defender for Cloud Apps
Exception Criteria: Business workflow requires offline access and has compensating controls
Rollback Method: Disable session control or restore limited access setting
Engineering Notes: Align SharePoint unmanaged-device settings with Conditional Access targeting.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Place new Conditional Access policies in report-only mode before enforcement unless responding to an active emergency
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Protection > Conditional Access
Validation Method: Review report-only logs across representative users, devices, applications and locations
Exception Criteria: Active threat requires expedited enforcement with executive approval
Rollback Method: Disable policy or revert to report-only
Review Cadence: For every new or materially changed policy
Engineering Notes: Document observation period, affected sign-ins, unexpected failures and approved exceptions.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Export policy JSON and document rollback actions before changing or enforcing a Conditional Access policy
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Graph and approved configuration repository
Validation Method: Compare exported policy ID and settings with portal configuration

Exception Criteria: Emergency change lacks prechange window
Rollback Method: Export immediately before modification whenever possible
Engineering Notes: Preserve policy ID, because recreating a policy generates a different object.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Allow only supported operating-system platforms and block unsupported enrollment types
Configuration or Review Path: Intune admin center > Devices > Enrollment > Enrollment restrictions
Validation Method: Attempt enrollment using representative supported and unsupported platforms
Evidence Required: Enrollment restriction export and test evidence
Exception Criteria: Device class has documented alternative management
Rollback Method: Restore prior platform restriction
Engineering Notes: Review both platform restrictions and version restrictions.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Block personal device enrollment for platforms where BYOD is not approved
Configuration or Review Path: Intune admin center > Devices > Enrollment > Enrollment restrictions
Validation Method: Attempt personal enrollment using test account and device
Exception Criteria: Documented BYOD business requirement
Rollback Method: Restore personal enrollment for scoped group
Engineering Notes: Ensure corporate ownership identifiers and Autopilot or Apple enrollment records are reliable before blocking.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Set an approved maximum number of enrolled devices per user, commonly five unless business needs require otherwise
Configuration or Review Path: Intune admin center > Devices > Enrollment > Device limit restrictions
Validation Method: Review assignment and attempt enrollment at the configured limit
Exception Criteria: Documented operational requirement for additional devices
Rollback Method: Increase scoped limit temporarily
Engineering Notes: Coordinate with stale-device cleanup to avoid blocking valid replacement devices.

Target Configuration or Required Action: Configure MDM user scope and automatic Intune enrollment for approved users
Configuration or Review Path: Microsoft Entra admin center > Mobility and Intune admin center
Validation Method: Join or register a pilot Windows device and confirm automatic enrollment

Target Configuration or Required Action: Monitor eligible devices not onboarded or inactive in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

Target Configuration or Required Action: Monitor real-time protection, cloud protection, definitions, engine status, tamper protection and scan health
